decisions.reason: The automatic airless spray gun builds directly on the firm's core spray application know-how and in-house manufacturing, so it can keep interpreting customer feedback and refining the product.
The manual airless gun is a staple accessory tied closely to the firm's existing pumps and customer base, which gives it strong absorptive capacity to sustain and improve it.
The air-assisted airless gun line extends established spray technology for industrial coating customers and fits the firm's knowledge base, so continued development is low-risk.
